title: Planning hearing notices outside newspapers in Bill 85
summary: Bill 85 would let hearing notices run in any suitable publication circulated across Maui County. Planning staff said the change would save the county money. One caller asked that notices also be posted on county bulletin boards.

timeline.text: Planning staff said the change would save the county money.
